blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Александр Пушкин, «Станционный смотритель».
exercises.context: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: В сенях я ___ (остановить / остановиться) и просил у ней позволения ее поцеловать; Дуня согласилась…
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Александр Пушкин, «Станционный смотритель».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.why: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Александр Пушкин, «Станционный смотритель».
exercises.context: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.q: Тут он стал подробно ___ (рассказывать / рассказать) мне свое горе.
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Александр Пушкин, «Станционный смотритель».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: При сих словах вышла из-за перегородки девочка лет четырнадцати, и ___ (побежать) в сени.
exercises.why: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI, Lesson 36. From Александр Пушкин, «Станционный смотритель».
exercises.context: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI,…

exercises.q: Ведь вы натешились ею; не ___ (погубить) ж ее по напрасну».
exercises.why: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37. From Александр Пушкин, «Станционный смотритель».
exercises.context: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37.

exercises.q: В ___ (комната) прекрасно-убранной Минский сидел в задумчивости.
exercises.why: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Александр Пушкин, «Станционный смотритель».
exercises.context: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: «Дочка-с,» ___ (отвечать / ответить) он с видом довольного самолюбия; «да такая разумная, такая проворная, вся в покойницу мать».
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Александр Пушкин, «Станционный смотритель».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: Под каждой картинкой ___ (прочесть / читать) я приличные немецкие стихи.
exercises.why: Both the imperfective and perfective forms of a Russian verb are to be memorized as a pair because there are no definite rules of forming one aspect from the other one: some twin-verbs differ only by a prefix in the perfective aspect; some have other changes: **читать** — **прочитать**, **получать** — **получить**. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Александр Пушкин, «Станционный смотритель».
exercises.context: Both the imperfective and perfective forms of a Russian verb are to be memorized as a pair because there are no definite rules of forming one aspect from the other one: some twin-verbs differ only by a prefix in the perfective aspect;…

exercises.q: Бедный отец на силу решился ___ (спросить / спрашивать) у дьячка, была ли она у обедни.
exercises.why: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Александр Пушкин, «Станционный смотритель».
exercises.context: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action.
